title: Character identity merges only on identical uppercase names; no alias merge
summary: Deterministic extraction keys characters by the uppercased dialogue name. The only alias handling merges case variants of the same string. Full-name and short-name variants such as 'JOHN' and 'JOHN DOE' stay separate assets.
notes: Location aliases exist only on location assets (project_assets.location_aliases). No alias logic was found for characters or props. Relevant to WD-IDEA-ASSET-046.

title: Action-line presence uses raw uppercase substring match
summary: Non-speaking character presence is set when the uppercased character key appears anywhere in an action line, with no word boundary. A short name can match inside a longer word or a different character's name.
notes: The manifest test covers dialogue counts and scene numbers; no test was found for word-boundary false positives. Impact on scene presence is not measured here.

title: Dialogue counts are computed but do not classify leads or extras
summary: Each character's dialogue line count is computed during extraction and reaches the UI only as preview mentionCount. No code path reads the count to separate main characters from one-line extras.
notes: Smoke script asserts the counts (scriptManifest.smoke.ts:80-82), which is not a jest test; the jest suite covers speakers and presence but no count assertion was found. Relevant to WD-IDEA-ASSET-041.

title: Shot-asset auto-population assigns every asset to every shot as throughout
summary: When Stage 8 or 9 loads, every missing (shot, scene instance) pair is inserted with presence_type throughout. The AssetDrawer add flow is different: it preselects heuristic matches and falls back to all shots when none match.
notes: Relevant to WD-IDEA-ASSET-204, -205, -206. Both defaults are present; the rule-based default in ASSET-206 is not the automatic one.

title: All Stage 12 export controls are disabled placeholders
summary: ExportSection renders Download MP4, YouTube, Google Drive and CapCut as buttons with no click handler, each with the disabled attribute. No export or download path for a finished video exists in the frontend.
notes: WD-IMPL-CAP-0281 lists the export options as a capability; this entry narrows it to placeholders. Relevant to WD-IDEA-PHIL-095 and -097.

title: voice_profile_id is stored on global assets and never read by generation
summary: Global asset create and update accept voiceProfileId and write voice_profile_id. No backend service or frontend component reads the field into image or video generation, so the voice seed described in the idea has no consumer.
notes: Searches: voice_profile|voiceProfile|elevenlabs across backend/src and src found only these sites. Relevant to WD-IDEA-ASSET-111.

title: Angle variants apply to characters only, including the matched-angle priority
summary: Multi-angle generation rejects non-character assets. In prompt assembly the matched angle is set only for characters; for other assets the priority is matched angle, then scene image, then master image.
notes: Relevant to WD-IDEA-ASSET-097 and -203. Props do not receive an angle variant.

title: Capsule libraries have no sharing flag; style-capsule images are public-read
summary: style_capsule_libraries has no public or shared column, and its select policy admits only the owner or preset rows. Separately, the storage policy for style-capsule images is public read for everyone.
notes: Relevant to WD-IDEA-ASSET-020 and -021. The public-read storage policy is the legacy workaround the idea describes.

title: Change Type keeps the approved image
summary: The asset_type branch of the project-asset update only sets asset_type and tracks the field. It does not clear image_key_url or attempts, so the image survives a type change.
notes: The test file covers PUT type rules; whether it asserts image retention was not checked line by line. Relevant to WD-IDEA-ASSET-106 and -107.

title: use_master_as_is defaults to FALSE in the schema
summary: The scene_asset_instances.use_master_as_is column is added with DEFAULT FALSE. Any default-checked behavior therefore has to come from UI code, which was not found to set it on creation.
notes: Relevant to WD-IDEA-ASSET-168. The UI default was not traced.

title: Upload modal has no session attempts carousel
summary: EnhancedUploadModal polls for job completion and shows the current preview, but it keeps no list of attempts from the session. The attempts carousel that exists is the persisted one in the Stage 5 and Stage 8 panels.

title: Status tags reach AI context; no tag templates, severity, conflicts or bulk tag tooling
summary: Per-instance status tags are placed into the AI context object and the scene asset payload. The tag editor offers carry-forward, but no template, severity, conflict check, history, bulk tagging or tag filter was found.
notes: Relevant to WD-IDEA-ASSET-192 through -199. Tags are not expanded into prompt phrases.

title: Any asset can be changed to extra_archetype through Change Type
summary: The PUT route validates asset_type against a list that includes extra_archetype and accepts it for any existing asset. A character can therefore become an archetype, although the idea records that path as rejected.
notes: Relevant to WD-IDEA-ASSET-076. The test file covers type changes, including cross-type merges; the archetype path was not checked specifically.
